title: [finding] `concept.mdx` documents a form section authored with `collapsed: true` and no `collapsible` — copied as written it renders the unopenable section objectui#9780 measured
body:
Filing gate: ① defect. Class **(a)** — 「示例照抄即失败是 (a)」: a published example that fails when copied verbatim, not an incomplete one.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat (`session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`, seat post #6017) out of the docs-corpus probe run while working #19311. ⛔ Unlabelled beyond `finding` and unassigned — `domain:*`, `type` and `priority:*` are the triage seat's sole production. The fix lands in `content/docs/**`.

## The carrier

`content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx:588-596` — a YAML example captioned **"Advanced section (collapsed by default)"** authoring `collapsed: true` on a form section with **no** `collapsible` beside it.

## Why copying it fails

`FormSectionSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:3315-3316`) declares both keys bare, with **no alias normalization** behind them:

```
collapsible: z.boolean().default(false),
collapsed:   z.boolean().default(false),
```

`FormSectionSchema.safeParse({collapsed: true})` returns `{collapsible: false, collapsed: true}`. Lit controls in the same run: `{collapsible: true}` → `{true,false}`, both → `{true,true}`, neither → `{false,false}` — so the instrument discriminates.

Downstream at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `87af769e9a3ee28ace099fdd653d3ebd79fe82e2` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0, self-proving), `packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx:609` and `:677` both pass `collapsible: section.collapsible` **alone**. ⇒ a section that starts closed with no toggle — exactly the defect **objectui#9780** measured.

⚠️ `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:1560` DOES apply the 2026-09-18 maintainer ruling (`Boolean(section.collapsible) || Boolean(section.collapsed)`). So the page is safe on one surface and unsafe on the other, which is why no gate catches it.

## Two siblings on the same page family, NOT the same class

Reported here so a fixer sees the whole shape, ⛔ but neither is (a) — they are silences, not copy-and-fail:

- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx:416-417` — the section key table reads `collapsible` = "Can section be collapsed", `collapsed` = "Initially collapsed", silent on the dependency the ruling settled.
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx:354-355`, `:422`, `:529`, `:835-836` — the same pair four more times. ⭐ The authored example at `:354-355` writes BOTH keys, so it is safe as written.

## Probe and its radius

`git grep -nw` per token over 216 tracked hand-written files in `content/docs`, generated `content/docs/references/**` excluded by pathspec. Tokens `collapsed` / `collapsible` / `collapse` / `fieldGroups` → 17 / 16 / 24 / 21 hit lines, 72 unique across 31 pages. Dark control `collapsable` = 0 (exit 1); lit control `defaultExpanded` = 1 (exit 0). ⛔ Not a double zero, so the instrument reads.

⚠️ **Radius limit, stated:** this probe sees a page that NAMES one of the four tokens. It does ⛔ NOT see a page describing collapse behaviour in prose with no key name at all.

`content/docs/releases/**` contributed 14 of the 72 lines across five pages — release-owned, read-only, none states the mapping rule, ⛔ none touched.

## Related, ⛔ not duplicates

- **#19311** — the spec-side declaration for this same pair. Still open and still unfixed on `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`; PR #19699 corrected a *different* pair on `object.zod.ts`.
- The `DrawerForm` residual is another repo's and wants a `Blocked-by:` link rather than a card here.

⚠️ The 2026-09-18 ruling REFUSED letters B (refuse the combination at the declaration) and C (a dev-only warning), so the remedy on the spec side is describe text only. This card is the docs side and is independent of that.

Dedupe words: `concept.mdx collapsed example unopenable` · `form section collapsed without collapsible doc` · `objectui 9780 documented example`
